judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Non-sequitur one-liners with drawn-out exclamations ('Yeeeugh!', 'Ew!') and the deadpan 'You're thinking of my brother, sorry' match Nox's goofy villager barks; leeches and urchins sneaking into a boathouse feel like lived-in local detail rather than plot exposition.
